name: Faded Shadowhide Pendant
summary: A voice now comes from the Faded Shadowhide Pendant, found in the Redridge Mountains. The Shadowhide gnolls wore it to receive orders from Morganth, and the delayed message is a spell cast by Theocritus.

sections.title: A Broken Network
sections.body: The Shadowhide gnolls of the Redridge Mountains follow Morganth and coordinate their movements through enchanted pendants. From his sanctuary at Tower Azora, High Mage Theocritus studied the talismans and devised a spell to breach their magical link. His broadcast took weeks to appear. This faded pendant proves the gnolls’ communication can be intercepted, giving Theocritus a way to disrupt Morganth’s reach.

sections.title: The Mage's Ambition
sections.body: Theocritus wants to study the pendant and learn how its enchantment endured his intrusion. He hopes to refine his sorcery until he can send disabling attacks through matching amulets worn across Redridge. The pendant must be brought to Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest so he can begin his work against Morganth’s hold over the region’s gnolls.

faq.q: What is the Faded Shadowhide Pendant?
faq.answer: The Faded Shadowhide Pendant was worn by Shadowhide gnolls in the Redridge Mountains to receive orders from Morganth. High Mage Theocritus’s broadcast spell has altered this pendant.

faq.q: Why does a voice speak from the pendant?
faq.answer: The voice is an echo of a spell High Mage Theocritus cast weeks ago. After months of study, he found a way to breach the pendants’ communication link, and the message shows his spell reached the gnolls’ network.
Theocritus is the High Mage at Tower Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. He studies dark threats across the border in Redridge, especially the rogue sorcerer Morganth.
Morganth is a sinister rogue magic-user in Redridge. He commands the local Shadowhide gnolls through enchanted pendants.

faq.q: What does Theocritus plan to do with the pendant?
faq.answer: Theocritus plans to study the pendant’s enchantment in his laboratory. He hopes to send disabling attacks through the network and incapacitate any gnoll wearing a matching pendant.

angles.text: As a Mage, you can see how magical interception can reach even crude or dark enchantments. A disciplined wizard can decode and hijack them.
As an Alliance member, you help Tower Azora weaken the Shadowhide gnolls threatening Elwynn Forest and Lakeshire.
